text:
maya: Heads up — saw a permission flicker in Console right after a KMS key rotation. A viewer briefly had an Edit button on project settings. Observed in prod ~2026-03-10 11:03 UTC. Anyone seen this pattern before?

jordan: Which cluster/region and repro steps? Any logs you can paste?

maya: us-west-2, prod. Repro (what I did): rotate key via kms-rotator -> deploy backend-roles v2. Logs around the time: 
```
2026-03-10T11:03:14Z auth=allow role_eval=viewer inherited_from=project:team-x cache_miss=true
2026-03-10T11:03:15Z ui_button=show name=edit_project permission_check=fallback error=kms_transient_timeout
2026-03-10T11:03:16Z audit=missing lookup=role_fetch failed_kms=true
```
Looks like role evaluation hit the fallback path when KMS returned a transient error. Also seeing an audit-log gap for ~11:03:14-11:04:00.

sahil: Re: UI gating — remember PR 4321 changed the short-circuit behavior for viewer->editor toggles (it moved a check earlier). That could interact with a fallback path.

ellie: Any customer-visible impact? I don't see a PagerDuty incident, but we got a support ping from ACME about the Edit button showing up briefly.

jordan: Quick mitigation: rolled back backend-roles v2 (PR #4389) and gated it behind feature flag. Starting rollback now :arrow_down_small:

ops-bot: Deploy started: backend-roles v2 revert (deploy-585) by jordan — https://ci.redwood.dev/build/585

auditor-bot: Alert: audit-log gap detected for service=auth between 11:03:00 and 11:05:00 UTC. Missing 42 events.

maya: Mitigations applied: re-enabled strict RBAC short-circuit, forced KV cache flush on auth nodes, and added a temporary check to hide edit buttons if permission eval returns fallback. Patch PR #4390. Hoping to close within 30m. :white_check_mark:

sahil: I'll add unit + e2e tests to cover KMS transient errors forcing fallback -> UI exposure. Also adding a regression that asserts UI gating is driven by final decision, not cache fallback.

ellie: Product requests a short customer notice and a postmortem. Can we confirm scope (# of affected orgs)?

jordan: Quick query I ran: `SELECT count(distinct org_id) FROM auth_eval WHERE ts BETWEEN 1670000000 AND 1670000600 AND fallback=true;` returned ~12 orgs. Will attach full export to the Jira.

maya: Created issue INF-2468: "Permission flicker during KMS rotation -> role fallback & audit gap" assigned to sahil + jordan. Added timeline, runbook, and customer-impact notes. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2468 :spiral_note_pad:

ellie: Thanks — scheduling a 1pm sync to walk compliance through the audit export and the timeline. Please bring any telemetry.

maya: On it. I'll ping compliance and drop the audit export + logs in the issue. If we see any further anomalies I'll update here immediately. :lock:
